intro: At Stormwind's gates, Field Marshal Stonebridge helps oversee the city's defenses with General Marcus Jonathan. She also receives reports and trophies from major victories.

p: Field Marshal Stonebridge watches the eastern archway at the entrance to the Valley of Heroes, beside Stormwind's main gates. A senior officer in the Grand Alliance, she works closely with General Marcus Jonathan. From the gate, she watches defenders, travelers, and returning champions enter the capital, ready to organize the garrison if danger breaches the outer defenses.

Field Marshal Stonebridge also receives reports and spoils from campaigns against great threats to the kingdom. Senior commanders rely on officers like her to confirm important intelligence and mark victories in the field, including the defeat of warlords and monsters in the crags of Blackrock Mountain.
